url.description: Production origin with no trailing slash. Used for canonical links and the sitemap.

updated.description: Default last-updated date for pages that do not set their own.

name.description: Shown as the byline. Leave empty to show the site name.

stage.description: 0 = before approval: the loader appears only on the home page and no ad units render. 1 = after approval: the loader appears on content pages and ad slots render where a slot id is set. Never on /portal/.

inArticle.description: Data-ad-slot id of a responsive display unit created in AdSense.

hash.description: Deep link used by /portal/#hash. Keep the original values (report1, report2, report5).

audience.description: Optional. Who the report is for. Shown in the facts panel when set.

cadence.description: Optional. How often the data refreshes, for example 'Daily by 9:00 AM Manila time'.

refreshed.description: Optional. Date the data was last refreshed (YYYY-MM-DD).

snapshot.description: Optional. Path to a screenshot in src/static/img, for example /img/champion-challenger.png. Make sure it contains no personal or client data.

snapshotAlt.description: Required when snapshot is set: one sentence stating the takeaway the image shows.
